_meta.notes: game_ids whose closing line has already been captured, so the */15 gate does not pull for them again. Keyed by The Odds API event id. Entries are dropped 14 days after kickoff. Written only after a pull succeeds — never before, so a failed pull retries.
_meta.missed_note: games whose close was NEVER captured and whose miss has already been reported as a GitHub issue comment. Tracked so the 6h lookback reports each game once instead of once every 15 minutes. These are losses, not recoveries.
